scope: Source-resolved listing bindings for offline weekly research (weekly-real-adapter). Positive bindings restrict a series to the SEC-sourced usable interval; no history outside it is asserted. No complete historical security-master correction.

recordContract.binding.validFrom/validTo: first weekly bar of the sourced usable interval / null = open while lastConfirmedCover is current
recordContract.historyGuard: sha256 of JSON.stringify(points in [checkedFrom, checkedTo]); adapter refuses the binding if it differs
recordContract.sources[]: accession, url, filingDate, sha256 of the fetched body (or of its first bytesRead bytes when complete=false), short quotes
